mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% signals aggressive monetary easing that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL declines below 1.0% year-over-year for two consecutive months, it signals disinflationary pressure that triggers Fed rate cuts, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad consumer demand shock that triggers fiscal stimulus, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through policy anticipation.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (HOUST and RSAFS both declining) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 9.0%) with declining employment (PAYEMS decreasing for two months), policy support for labor market stabilization drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the regime condition, or the regime-specific return is not significantly higher than the overall average (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals manufacturing contraction that precedes policy intervention, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 600,000 units, it signals a housing sector contraction that triggers government stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 1.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of low inflation periods, or the regime-specific return is not significantly higher than the average (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) indicates labor market deterioration that triggers policy response, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through market anticipation of stabilization.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (UNRATE rising and PAYEMS falling) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05).
